name: Snap Scroll Gallery
description: Full-screen vertical photo gallery with scroll snapping, a fixed pill navigation that animates the page to a chosen photo, and a caption card that slides in for the active image.
contents: Fixed top navigation with one link per item
Caption card with title, description and photo credit link
behavior: Page scroll snaps to each full-screen image
Active item is detected from the scroll position and highlights its nav link
Clicking a nav link scales the current image down and eases the page scroll to the target
Caption slides in from the right for the active image
editableByProps: Images, titles, descriptions and credit links
Active and hover colors of nav links and credit links
Scroll duration per step and caption width
